subject: REWRITE statement
notes: Rule: 'The figurative constant SPACE when specified in the REWRITE statement references one alphanumeric space character.' cite.py --check 14.9.35.4 -> OK 8). With record-name-1, GR7 makes the FROM a MOVE, and MOVE of a one-character alphanumeric space to the record space-fills it, which is what the bound implicit MOVE of the figurative produces. Probe probe/rewrite-statement-p2/p2.cob: `REWRITE F1-REC FROM SPACE` -> FROMSP=00 F1=[      ], read back [      ]. The FILE-phrase context where the one-character length would matter is barred by SR10 b) (no figurative with FILE) and A.4.13 is declined (PB282, landed). No spec-derived golden -> test-needed.
